title: RACE: Calibrated Cumulative Scoring for Rollout-Free Robot Policy Checkpoint Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.05838v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Assessing the deployment performance of learned robot policies during training is challenging, as directly measuring task success requires costly real-world trials for each candidate checkpoint. Averaged validation loss offers a rollout-free alternative, but its checkpoint rankings can be inconsistent with deployment performance. We analyze two limitations of this criterion: it penalizes action deviations without considering whether the policy can recover from them, and gives later reference predictions equal weight even when earlier deviations may lead execution away from the reference. We propose RACE, a novel rollout-free metric for ranking checkpoints using a fixed set of held-out successful trajectories. RACE calibrates action deviations against state-conditional thresholds derived from action differences at similar states in these trajectories. translated_title: RACE：用于免执行机器人策略检查点选择的校准累积评分方法
translated_abstract: 在训练过程中评估已学习机器人策略的部署性能具有挑战性，因为直接衡量任务成功与否需要对每个候选检查点进行代价高昂的真实世界试验。平均验证损失提供了一种无需真实执行的替代方案，但其对检查点的排序可能与部署性能不一致。我们分析了该标准的两个局限性：它在惩罚动作偏差时并未考虑策略能否从这些偏差中恢复过来；并且即使早期的偏差可能使执行过程偏离参考轨迹，后期的参考预测仍被赋予同等权重。我们提出了RACE，一种新颖的免执行检查点排序指标，它利用一组固定的留出成功轨迹进行评估。RACE根据这些轨迹中相似状态下的动作差异推导出状态条件阈值，并以此校准动作偏差。我们通过运行乘积将这些分数进行聚合，使得较大的偏差能够……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RACE——一种无需真实执行的机器人策略检查点选择指标，通过基于状态条件阈值校准动作偏差并用累积乘积聚合评分，使检查点排序与真实部署性能更加一致。
en_tdlr: RACE is a rollout-free metric for robot policy checkpoint selection that calibrates action deviations with state-conditional thresholds and aggregates them via a cumulative product, yielding checkpoint rankings that better align with deployment performance.
